stem:
Nidhi adds a few drops of iodine solution to a piece of boiled corn. The corn turns blue-black.

What does the colour show?

options.text: Starch is present in the corn.
Protein is present in the corn.
Starch is present even if the corn had not turned blue-black.
Every part of the corn cob, including the hard outer husk, must contain starch.

teacher.key_rationale: Blue-black with iodine indicates starch. Protein swaps the nutrient term; claiming starch without the colour omits the test result; extending starch to every part including the husk over-widens the claim.
